value.rationale: This resolves the genuinely unrestricted exact fourth-moment and equality problem for the smallest quartic graph with nontrivial cube-root collisions after earlier work provided only energy and a fixed-space norm. The exact positive mixed-arm penalty shows why a larger sampling curve never improves upon a design subcurve, a structural localization phenomenon not inferable from the one-arm constant alone. A complete finite natural problem and sharp equality classification are valuable even without a general-q theorem.
